notes.title: Devblog 6
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug when connected player didn't get a costume at the first appearance
Fixed a bug when the character died due to oxygen deficiency after revival
Fixed a bug when lowering texture quality led to lowering interface quality as well
Fixed a bug when size of an object was bigger than boxes in the inventory
Fixed a bug when it was impossible to create a universe with the same name
Fixed gravity in gateway
The way gateway works is fixed
Fixed quality of several textures on low graphics settings
Graphical artifacts on the screen are fixed
Fixed a bug when being in a room with oxygen without costume didn't regain oxygen parameter
Fixed a bug when we loaded in space, but oxygen wasn't being consumed
Fixed a bug of invalid oxygen parameter calculation in gateway
Fixed a bug that led to spawning asteroids inside space devices
Fixed a bug with falling beneath floor after exiting the construction mode
Fixed cursor freezing in the construction mode
Fixed a bug when characters were visible in the construction mode
Fixed a bug with dropping items from the inventory
Fixed a bug with picking up items
Fixed a bug when objects in hands could be displayed incorrectly
Fixed a bug when on first opening of the inventory items in it didn't match with the boxes
Fixed a bug when while controlling a ship and the inventory was open, we could steel rotate the ship
Cockpit interface is fixed
Changed chat interface
Costume's oxygen refill rate in the suit storage module is halved
Added HUD beacons concealment when the inventory is open
Added helmet interface attenuation when the inventory is open
Added a function of overwriting the saves when a new game is started
Added oxygen preservation in space device
Added parameter saving for life-support module
Multi-player. Fixed loading of space devices
Multi-player. Fixed space device network optimization
Multi-player. Fixed loading of maneuver engines
Multi-player. Character movement physics inside ships is fixed, now you can walk around the deck without problems while the vessel is moving
Multi-player. Ship control is fixed
Multi-player. Fixed a bug when it was possible to enter cockpit when there already was a pilot
Multi-player. Fixed cockpit animation playback
Multi-player. Fixed a bug sometimes occurring on entering a server that led to ship duplication

notes.title: Devblog 5
notes.notes:
Fixed an aspect of inventory saving 
Fixed asteroid saving and loading
Fixed accumulator interface display
Fixed the way character moves while walking
Fixed several aspects of crafting 
Fixed a bug connected with things in player’s hands not colliding with objects
Fixed a bug of impossibility to save when an asteroid is exhausted
Fixed a bug appearing when after 2 deaths characters can’t be revived on their station
Fixed phantom appearing and disappearing of asteroids
Fixed a problem when after death we fell through the floor (on a debugging stage, we’re waiting for your feedback)
Fixed the world saving algorithm, when several sector parts could load in someone other’s sector, including asteroids
Fixed a bug connected with FPS drops and other problems, when a message history in chat is big
Fixed a problem of possible game crashes under certain conditions
Fixed third-person view camera while in a ship

Changed helmet interface
Changed character interface
Changed revival interface
Changed glass material in a cockpit
Changed bloom material (glow)
Changed post-editing effects, tweaked blur

Added character review with tools in hands
Added the world optimization
Added a limit for up to 29 messages in chat history

And several more minor fixes of the game code, that weren’t included in this list

notes.title: DEVBLOG 4
notes.notes:
Fixed water crafting
Fixed interface of craft in the stationary module
Fixed bug when the right part of cells in inventory wasn't available
Fixed bug when eating food and after saving and loading the quantity of water came back to a last value
Fixed saving of objects in the construction module (storage)
Fixed saving space suit in the module of storage of a space suit

Crafting rules in the stationary module is changed, now for crafting you need to have resources in the inventory of the character
Changed the hunger time interval from 60s to 90s
Changed the thirst time interval from 80s to 120s
The interface of the module of storage space suit is changed
Changed color of particles of engines
Changed the texture of the generator
The chance of a spawn of an asteroid "stone" is reduced from 45% to 23%
The chance of a spawn of an asteroid "silver" is increased from 5% to 16%
The chance of a spawn of an asteroid "gold" is increased from 15% to 18%
The chance of a spawn of an asteroid "flint" is increased from 8% to 22%
The chance of a spawn of an asteroid "iron" is reduced from 35% to 24%
The chance of a spawn of an asteroid "aluminum" is increased from 15% to 21%

Added suit oxygen generation in the module of storage of a space suit
Added generation of energy of a space suit in the module of storage space suit
The feature to automatic processing of ore is added, just drag a piece of ore in the stationary module and he automatically will be stands in line on processing
